zones.label: Notice Harm
zones.summary: Recognize the action, crossed boundary, and effect on the other person.
facts: Safety comes before repairing the relationship.

zones.label: Take Responsibility
zones.summary: Name what you did without blaming the other person.

zones.label: Listen
zones.summary: Hear the other person’s experience and needs without arguing.
facts: Do not demand emotional labor or immediate forgiveness.

zones.label: Repair
zones.summary: Offer a concrete action that addresses the harm when possible.
facts: Ask what would be useful rather than assuming.
Some harm requires adult or professional help.

zones.label: Rebuild Trust
zones.summary: Trust returns through consistent behavior over time, if the other person chooses.
facts: A relationship may change or end after a boundary violation.
